Steady Income strategy results for the periods ending December 31, 2025, published here for every visitor: 1 year 8.9% gross, 7.8% net; 5 years 7.1% gross, 6.0% net; 10 years 7.6% gross, 6.5% net (5- and 10-year figures are average annual returns). The strategy holds a fixed 60/40 mix of two broad index funds, rebalanced each January, and net figures deduct the 1.00% annual advisory fee and trading costs. Results have inherent limitations, and the strategy could have lost money in any period; full records are available on request.
